program: CUSTOMER INSTALLER / SECOND LAB — Stage A
base_tip_subject: Merge Wave 3 Track 15 public claim and content inventory onto main. Source-only. Frozen inventory.
fail_closed_extensions: APPLIED can move to INTERRUPTED when the process dies before health is recorded
VERIFIED_REMOVED and RESIDUAL_PRESENT can be re-checked
VERIFYING_REMOVAL moves to FAILED_SAFE when a residual probe returns UNKNOWN
residual_gaps: Live Docker, npm, BPF, and traffic-control commands are constructed and tested as argument lists. The live executor refuses to run them, including when VANTIO_INSTALL_ALLOW_LIVE=1. A later authorized clean-host run has to execute that path.
Fixture tests prove the transaction, rollback, residual check, support-bundle redaction, and independent verifier. They are not a clean-host proof. proof_state stays NOT_PROVED.

The sealed Phantom Engine archive and Optics tarballs are not vendored. The installer pins the frozen digests and refuses a mismatch. Happy-path fixtures inject those digest fields in-process so the same comparator can pass on small files. A subprocess plan against the real pin table and stand-in bytes is PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED.
No second AWS lab, no GHCR publish, no Paid conversion, and no public announcement were performed.
summary: Stage A adds a dedicated vantio-install package and an independent vantio-verify command. The frozen Optics CLI, agent SDK, and Phantom Engine identities are unchanged. Observe-only is the only install mode. Twenty-nine fixture tests passed locally.
